messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected for enterprise account "Lyra Connect" (org_id: lyra-001) in eu-west-1. 15% 504s and several model timeouts reported across dedicated pool. Trigger: 5xx spike + repeat client timeouts. Pager: SRE primary. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/lyra-eu-connectivity

Maya SRE: Acked. I'm oncall. Looking at ingress and model pool health.

Ajay Patel: I'm seeing elevated queue depth on dedicated-pool-eu-01. `grafana -> /d/serve/queue` shows backlog. Can someone check autoscaler logs?

Samir Liu: Checking autoscaler. No recent scale-up events in last 12m. `kubectl get hpa -n redwood-serving` shows target CPU stable. I can trigger a manual scale if needed.

Maya SRE: Before manual scale, can we confirm whether this is routing or model process slowdown? `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}"` against a slow request gives `504 12.3s` and the model container logs show repeated `KVCache miss` + GC spikes.

Emily Chen: Customer impact: Lyra Connect has live traffic for billing runs queued. They have 2k active seats; they reported errors via their account dashboard and emailed cs-ops@lyra.example. We need a tailored customer note.

Jordan Park: Please include their primary SRE contact (cc): sam.k@lyra.example and engineering lead nina@lyra.example. Also include out-of-hours phone for PagerDuty -> +1-415-555-0199.

Maya SRE: Mitigation steps I'm executing now: 1) draining slow nodes from pool, 2) forcing a scale-up of dedicated-pool-eu-01 by +2 GPUs, 3) enabling degraded fallback to model-variant-1 (lower mem footprint) for Lyra-specific routing. Will update once green.

ops-bot: Action taken: scaled dedicated-pool-eu-01 from 8 -> 10 GPUs. Command: `infractl scale --pool dedicated-pool-eu-01 --replicas 10` (initiated by Maya SRE)

Ajay Patel: I pushed routing override to send Lyra traffic to model-variant-1 with the following policy: `route: lyra-001 -> model-variant-1 (pref=100, fallback=auto)`

Maya SRE: Observability: error rate dropping to 2.1% from 15% over last 3m. Latency p50 down to 320ms. Still monitoring for regressions.

Emily Chen: Draft customer notification (please review/edit):

```
Subject: Service disruption affecting Lyra Connect in EU region
Hi Sam / Nina,
We're currently investigating higher-than-normal errors and timeouts affecting Lyra Connect traffic in eu-west-1. Our engineers have identified a subset of model workers experiencing resource pressure and have started scaling and routing Lyra traffic to a stable model variant. You may see transient errors as we complete remediation. Estimated recovery: <30 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary.
Actions we're taking:
- Immediate scale-up of your dedicated pool
- Routing to a stable model variant to reduce errors
- Dedicated engineer monitoring until full recovery
If you need live updates or phone contact, reply and we'll coordinate.
— Redwood Inference Ops
```

Jordan Park: Good. Add note about credits/compensation threshold and cc legal if recovery >4h.

Maya SRE: Status page update draft (short): `We are investigating increased errors for Lyra Connect in eu-west-1. Mitigation underway; some customers may see transient 504s. ETA: 30min.`

Samir Liu: Logs show one model variant binary had an infinite GC loop after a failed quantization job yesterday. I recommend we quarantine that binary and run a rolling redeploy to avoid recurrence.

Maya SRE: Agreed. Next steps: quarantine faulty binary, redeploy model-variant-2 on a rolling basis, keep routing Lyra to variant-1 until stable. Assigning follow-up ticket: INF-4521.

Emily Chen: I'll send the customer notification now and open a high-touch support ticket. Sending copy to Lyra contacts and internal account owner.

Maya SRE: Update at +15m: error rate steady ~1.5%. Keeping this thread open for 1hr post-recovery. If we hit >3% again, re-escalate to paging + exec notify.

Ajay Patel: Ack. I'll own the post-incident RCA with Samir.

incident-bot: Incident note: generated timeline entry and linked INF-4521. Auto-ack duration: 01:00:00. Reminder: update status page when issue resolved.

Maya SRE: Closing loop — moving to monitoring. If anyone wants to add details to the customer postmortem, add to INF-4521.
